playbookOutputs: CIPC co-operative registration certificate with registration number
Founding member register and first board details (client copy)
playbookCommonFailures: Fewer than the minimum number of founding members for the co-operative type (primary co-op needs at least 5 natural persons)
Constitution missing mandatory clauses required by the Co-operatives Act (objectives, membership, surplus distribution, board)
Certified ID of a founding member older than 3 months or a member is under 18 without guardian consent
Proposed name too similar to an existing co-operative or does not end with 'Co-operative Limited' / 'Primary Co-operative'
Registered office proof of address missing

informationToProvide.label: Certified copies of Identity Documents for all founding members
informationToProvide.aiHint: One certified SA ID (Smart Card front and back or Green Book) or passport per founding member, Commissioner of Oaths / SAPS stamp dated within 3 months. Count the members — a primary co-operative needs at least five natural persons.

informationToProvide.label: Proof of address for all founding members
informationToProvide.aiHint: Proof of residential address dated within 3 months per founding member (utility bill, rates, lease or bank statement).

informationToProvide.label: Proposed name for the co-operative society (with alternatives)
informationToProvide.helpText: Up to four names in order of preference; CIPC adds 'Primary Co-operative Limited'.
informationToProvide.aiHint: Up to four names. No special characters.

informationToProvide.label: Details of the co-operative's primary objectives and activities
informationToProvide.helpText: What the co-op will do (e.g. agricultural, housing, worker, financial services, consumer) and its main objectives.

informationToProvide.label: Physical address for the registered office of the co-operative
Proof of address for the registered office
informationToProvide.aiHint: Utility bill, lease or letter from the property owner for the registered office address, dated within 3 months.

informationToProvide.label: Names of the first board of directors and office bearers (chairperson, secretary, treasurer)

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Collect founding members, objectives, names and addresses
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certified IDs and proof of address for every founding member, proposed names, objectives, registered office and first board received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain the co-operative types (primary, secondary, tertiary) and that a primary co-op needs at least five natural-person members; ⚠ verify the current minimum for each type and sector (worker co-ops and financial co-ops have extra rules). Ask about the sector: financial services co-ops (savings/credit) need additional regulatory approval — flag for Kevin. Turnaround 7-10 working days; never promise faster.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Verify members, name availability and requirements
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: All uploads pass; member count meets the minimum; names screened; office bearers are members
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Cross-check the member list against IDs and proofs of address — every member needs both. Office bearers must be founding members. Search CIPC for similar co-operative names. Confirm all members are 18+ (minors require guardian consent — flag).

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft the co-operative constitution
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Constitution drafted from the CIPC model constitution, tailored to the objectives, and reviewed by Kevin
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Kevin drafts (or adapts the CIPC model constitution) — professional judgement. Mandatory content under the Co-operatives Act 14 of 2005: name and type, objectives, registered office, membership qualifications and withdrawal, shares/membership fees, general meetings, board composition and elections, surplus and reserve allocation, audit/accounting, amendment and dissolution. The agent can pre-fill the factual fields from the questionnaire and post a draft with gaps flagged.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Draft founding documents handoff sheet and founding resolution
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Handoff sheet with every CR form field (members, board, office bearers, office address, name, type, sector) and founding meeting resolution drafted
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: ⚠ verify the current CIPC co-operative forms (CR1 application, CR5 director/member particulars, CR8 name reservation and their e-Services equivalents). The founding meeting resolution records adoption of the constitution and election of the first board, signed by all founding members.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Send constitution and founding documents for signature
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Constitution signed by all founding members and signed founding resolution uploaded
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Explain that every founding member signs the constitution and the founding resolution, and that the office bearers sign the application forms. Return as PDF.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Reserve name and file co-operative registration on CIPC
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Name reserved, registration lodged with constitution, member IDs and forms; fee paid; tracking number saved
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Kevin files. CIPC e-Services > Co-operatives: reserve the name, then register with the signed constitution, application form, member particulars and certified IDs. ⚠ verify current fees and the exact channel (e-Services vs emailed pack to the co-operatives unit). Record the tracking number.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Wait for CIPC registration
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Registration certificate issued or CIPC query received
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Check tracking status on e-Services before following up. Queries usually concern the constitution wording or member count — route to Kevin verbatim.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Deliver registration certificate and constitution
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Certificate, registered constitution and member register posted to Communication History
fulfillmentChecklist.aiInstructions: Briefly explain ongoing duties: annual general meeting, annual financial statements / audit as the Act requires, annual return to CIPC, SARS income tax registration and possible exemption. Offer the bank account and SARS registration services.

fulfillmentChecklist.title: Final sign-off
fulfillmentChecklist.doneCriteria: Kevin confirms the order can be completed
